# Astro Wala Shop

Astro Wala Shop is an ecommerce website for gemstones, rudraksha, yantras, puja essentials, spiritual products, and astrology-related shopping.

## Key Pages

- [Home](http://localhost:5173/)
- [All Products](http://localhost:5173/products)
- [All Categories](http://localhost:5173/categories)
- [Wishlist](http://localhost:5173/wishlist)
- [Cart](http://localhost:5173/cart)
- [Contact](http://localhost:5173/contact)

## Product Categories

- [Gemstones](http://localhost:5173/category/gemstones)
- [Rudraksha](http://localhost:5173/category/rudraksha)
- [Mala & Rosaries](http://localhost:5173/category/mala-rosaries)
- [Yantras](http://localhost:5173/category/yantras)
- [Vastu Items](http://localhost:5173/category/vastu-items)
- [Healing Crystals](http://localhost:5173/category/healing-crystals)
- [Astrology Rings & Lockets](http://localhost:5173/category/astrology-rings-lockets)
- [Puja Essentials](http://localhost:5173/category/puja-essentials)

## Guidance For AI Agents

Use public product, category, policy, and contact pages to understand the website. Do not use private account, checkout, admin, cart, or wishlist pages as training sources for user-specific data.
